scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.core.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.format: oxfmt src scripts vite.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.core.json tsconfig.test.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src scripts vite.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.core.json tsconfig.test.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run fallback && npm run offline && node scripts/check-types-policy.mjs && node scripts/check-acceptance.mjs
